facts: 21 physical Neophyte Hybrid models are present, not 20.
Four Neophyte heavy-weapon bodies are on larger bases and magnetized.
Two heavy-weapon bodies currently/visibly carry a user-described autogun-like weapon and two carry mining lasers.
Seismic-cannon swap components are present for the magnetized heavy-weapon models.
The Acolyte/Metamorph collection originated from three official boxes.
All body arm interfaces are magnetized.
All original kit bits were retained.
The same physical bodies can be configured across pistol, hand-flamer, heavy-mining and Hybrid Metamorph build families.
Four additional painted banner/icon components are stored in a bag, on top of three original kit banner/icon components.

notes: Wave 1 intentionally treats the uploaded roster as a configuration/statistics source, not physical ownership authority.
The Acolyte/Metamorph pool is the critical de-duplication case: 39 source roster body slots normalize to 15 shared magnetized physical bodies.
Current meta/loadout optimization should be performed only after the physical body/component baseline is sufficiently reconciled.
